BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: IMSC   SEMESTER: IV
BRANCH: ALL   SESSION : SP/2019

SUBJECT : IMC4001 CHEMISTRY - IV

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) What do you mean by a Eutectic system? What is Eutectic point? [2]
 (b) NH
4
Cl  is  being  dissociated  in  a  closed  vessel.  Calculate  the  number  of  phases  (P),
components (C) and degree of freedom (F).
[3]

Q2 (a) Draw cooling curve for a molten mixture of 97.4% Pb & 2.6% Ag. [2]
 (b) Draw a neat phase diagram of water system. Discuss the behaviour of various equilibriums
involved in the system with varying pressure and temperature.
[3]

Q3 (a) What do you mean by transport number or transference number of ions? [2]
 (b) Explain how Van’t Hoff’s relation provides evidence in support of Arrhenius theory of
electrolytic dissociation.
[3]

Q4 (a) What are reversible and non reversible electrochemical cells? [2]
 (b) Discuss in details the determination of chloride ions through conductometric titration
against standardized silver nitrate solution.
[3]

Q5 (a) What are bidentate chelates? Illustrate with an example. [2]
 (b) Discuss the salient features of Werner’s theory of coordination compounds. [3]

Q6 (a) Give the name and structure of a hexadentate ligand.  [2]
 (b) Give example of a pair of ionization isomers and how they differ in reaction with chemical
reagents.
[3]
